text_block_list.text: Ouch!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I screwed up... I think I twisted my
ankle...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I check the swollen area and find it
hotter than
expected. This may warrant
extra caution.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Don't get any ideas! I can still run.
Believe me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Let's take it easy for a while.
I'll do my best to patch you up.

text_block_list.text: For a while... Hey, how long is that?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
We don't have that kind of time. It's
fine, so let's
just hurry up and—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I explain that running while trying to
bear the
pain may lead to unwanted
changes in her running
form.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Tch! Fine. You have a point.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Okay, thanks.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Agh!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан grimaces the moment I start
patching
her up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: I think we need to take the day off, after all.

text_block_list.text: Hey, this is noth—ouch!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...Tch! Fine. If that's what you think is
best.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
All right, thanks. I want to get back to
training as
soon as you're done wrapping
me up.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: I'm not gonna let you overdo things.

text_block_list.text:
Hmph, overdo it? You're a trainer, aren't
you?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Whatever happens, you know how to
bandage
and apply ice. And I know
you'll take care of me
properly.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...Hey, what's with the grin? Just take
care of it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
The treatment is effective and Narita
Brian
overcomes her injury.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'll hold off for now...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Forced to take a break, Нарита Брайан
doesn't look
happy when she leaves the
infirmary.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
